caption: Pipeline of Paper 1. SoLEXS and HEL1OS Level-1 products (831 SoLEXS days, 2668 HEL1OS products) are gridded to 20 s in a per-product cache, turned into 24 + 48 features with trailing backgrounds, and cut into 2 h windows split chronologically with 27-day embargoes. The same network is trained on SoLEXS only (E1), HEL1OS only (E2) and both (E4); thresholds, probability calibration and interval widths are fixed on validation and applied once to the test period. GOES-18 XRS supplies the labels (flares >= C1.0) and the flux target, and is never a model input.
